Using the standard form of the Maclaurin series of sin⁡x, find the first three non-zero terms of the series expansion of the definite integral ∫0πxsin⁡(2x)dx.

a
∫0πxsin⁡(2x)dx=π2−4π33+4π415+⋯⋯
b
∫0πxsin⁡(2x)dx=π2−π36+π412+⋯
c
∫0πxsin⁡(2x)dx=π2−4π39+π415+⋯⋯
d
∫0πxsin⁡(2x)dx=π−π22+π36+⋯
e
∫0πxsin⁡(2x)dx=π−π2+π39+⋯
